items.heading: Grapevine Daily Quote October 30
items.text: When I look into the eyes of the person next to me and ask, ‘How are you?’, I will take the time to listen. I want to keep in mind that at any given time, each of us may need the same love and support as someone who is attending their first meeting.
items.attribution: “Taking the Time to Listen,” Jacksonville Beach, Florida, December 1997, Voices of Long-Term Sobriety

items.heading: Cita Diaria con La Viña Octubre 30
items.text: La verdad no es un arma para ser usada a la ligera ... Cuando me piden mi opinión o un consejo, hago lo mejor que puedo con la mayor gentileza, comprensión y tolerancia posibles.
items.attribution: “La verdad”. CAYO HUESO, FLORIDA, AGOSTO DE 1973
items.source: Lo mejor del Grapevine, Volumen I
